Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator prematurely concluded that the request was satisfied after WebSurfer only navigated to a specific gene region page on the Ensembl website. The agent failed to verify that this specific page contained the "most relevant files" for the entire dog genome as of May 2020. Instead of searching for the main genome assembly download page or verifying the version date of the assembly (ROS_Cfam_1.0) against the May 2020 requirement, the Orchestrator accepted a generic gene browser link as the final answer. This led to providing a URL that points to a specific gene locus rather than the repository of genome files requested by the user.
